shared_elements: low-relief motifs on a tall vertical pillar/anthropomorphic monolith
horizontal band running across the shaft dividing registers
band filled with repeated small marks/zigzag
curved paired elements descending from the shoulders (arms/hands or snake-like forms) converging toward the front
stacked registers of motifs down the shaft
flat raised silhouettes with plain interiors
justification: Both surfaces are tall pillars carved in flat, raised, schematic relief with stacked registers: a disc/boss and curving paired arm-like elements above, a horizontal band of repeated marks crossing the shaft, and further motifs beneath it — a distinctive shared scheme of an anthropomorphised pillar with a belt-like divider. The biggest difference in content is that B's registers are populated with recognisable creatures (quadruped, bird, small figures) while A's are almost entirely abstract (rosette-like disc, V-shape, plain bands), so no specific animal motif can be matched between them.
